connector.name: Citeguard by Franksterino
connector.registryDescription: Verify citations in AI text: fetches each cited source, returns verdicts with evidence quotes.
connector.summary: Hosted at citeguard.boundy.workers.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package citeguard. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the franksterino account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.
